item_name: Rothco Molon Labe Deluxe Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Molon Labe Deluxe Low Profile Cap is embroidered with the iconic saying and rifle artwork on the front panel in silver. Molon Labe translates to “come and take them”.  The 100% brushed cotton twill cap features a padded sweatband for added comfort and a hook and loop closure in the back for adjustability.
